how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-depths-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3801:obj:0: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.
rows.quest:3801:details:0: Greetings, ⟦1⟧. I am Franclorn Forgewright. Yes, the Franclorn Forgewright responsible for the stonewrought method of architecture. You have undoubtedly passed through or stood upon one of my creations in your adventures across our war torn world.
rows.quest:3801:details:1: BYou are probably wondering why I am here and what it is that I want from you - both valid questions.
rows.quest:3801:details:2: BI need your assistance, of course. In exchange for your assistance, I shall grant you the key to the depths of my accursed city.
rows.quest:3801:completion:0: Whether it is greed which brought you here or an act of selfless devotion, what you are about to undertake is for the good of us all.
rows.quest:3802:obj:0: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.
rows.quest:3802:details:0: You will find Fineous Darkvire beyond the Ring of Law, in the Hall of Crafting. Kill the miserable cur and recover Ironfel.
rows.quest:3802:details:1: BTake Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place the hammer in its rightful place: In the hands of the statue erected in my honor.
rows.quest:3802:details:2: BWhen this is done, the compartment in which I stored the ⟦E1⟧ will open. More importantly, Ironfel will remain forever in my grasp. Should they make an attempt to remove the hammer; both the statue and hammer will shatter, lost forever.
rows.quest:3802:completion:0: The hammer slides firmly into place, within the grasp of the massive Dark Iron monument. A tiny compartment opens at the base of the statue. Inside you find...
rows.quest:3907:obj:0: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.⟦2⟧
rows.quest:3907:details:0: I can taste the foulness in the air that surrounds you, ⟦3⟧. There is another, hidden in the depths of Blackrock, who does control this foulness.
rows.quest:3907:details:1: BThe wind and earth cry his name: Lord Incendius... but someone... something... commands this being. He is merely an emissary.
rows.quest:3907:details:2: BFind him and discover where his master hides. Return to me when you have collected this information.⟦4⟧
rows.quest:3907:completion:2: BThe elders were right to fear the corruption emanating from Blackrock Mountain. A general of the Old Gods! IN OUR WORLD! We must reassess our position here in Kargath. We must decide on whether we stay and fight or run for fear of a new sundering.
rows.quest:3907:completion:3: BBe weary of any further exploration in Blackrock Mountain, ⟦5⟧. A far greater evil than anything that exists in this world resides in those fiery depths.
rows.quest:3981:obj:0: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
rows.quest:3981:obj:1: BYou recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.
rows.quest:3981:details:0: Poor Gargal... didn't even see it coming. WHAM! The arrow landed dead center on the top of his head. He was no genius before but now...
rows.quest:3981:details:2: BWhen we dislodged the arrow, we noticed a rolled up note attached to the shaft. On the note was a crudely drawn picture of an orc behind bars with the signature of Commander Gor'shak attached.
rows.quest:3981:details:3: BIf he's still alive in the Depths, you'll have to find him.
rows.quest:3981:details:4: BA trap you say? Well no kidding, numb hooves! That's why you're going!⟦7⟧
rows.quest:3981:completion:0: We haven't got much time. Listen carefully, ⟦8⟧. What I have to tell you is classified and for your ears only.
rows.quest:3982:details:0: I was sent here under the auspices of Thrall. Do you actually think these buffoons could capture me? I allowed myself to be captured so that I could gather intelligence.
rows.quest:3982:details:2: BThe Princess of ⟦E2⟧ has been kidnapped by Emperor Thaurissan. Princess Bronzebeard is in this very city! I bet old Magni's heart almost stopped when he heard that news.
rows.quest:3982:details:4: BShhh! Do you hear that? Guards coming! DEFEND YOURSELF!
rows.quest:3982:completion:0: That was a close call. They have been alerted to your presence... more will surely come.
rows.quest:4001:obj:0: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess ⟦E3⟧'s kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4001:obj:1: BYou recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.⟦11⟧
rows.quest:4001:details:0: So far, my communication with the dwarf, Kharan, in the cell across the hall, has been limited. I have, however, managed to convince him that I, rather -we- mean him no harm.
rows.quest:4001:details:1: BGo speak with him and gather as much information about the Princess and her captors as possible. Take that information back to the Warchief.
rows.quest:4001:details:2: BThrall does not want the Princess harmed, but instead, has some grand plan laid out, which includes her being safely returned to ⟦E2⟧. Kharan already knows all of this... Go!⟦12⟧
rows.quest:4001:completion:0: This is a chance for the ⟦E5⟧ to change the political climate of our war torn world forever. Listen carefully, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:4001:completion:1: BFailure of this mission is not an option.
rows.quest:4002:obj:0: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.
rows.quest:4002:details:1: BAs Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the ⟦E5⟧. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.
rows.quest:4002:details:2: BThe opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the ⟦E6⟧. This, then, is why you must not fail!
rows.quest:4002:completion:0: There is no going back beyond this point, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:4003:obj:0: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess ⟦E3⟧ from his evil spell. ⟦16⟧
rows.quest:4003:details:0: This strike against the Dark Iron dwarves, if successful, will send a shockwave throughout their entire kingdom.
rows.quest:4003:details:1: BPrincess Bronzebeard is under the control of Emperor Thaurissan. To free her, you must kill the Emperor. Be warned, your task is doubly dangerous, as Bronzebeard will attack you without question while under the control of the Emperor.
rows.quest:4004:details:0: You have slain my husband, ⟦18⟧! My child will be born into this world without a father.
rows.quest:4004:details:1: B<Princess Moira points directly at you.>
rows.quest:4004:details:2: BI assure you, this child will be the next ruler of the kingdom of ⟦E2⟧. You and your kind shall be hunted down until the end of days for this wrongful act.
rows.quest:4004:details:3: B<You think that Princess Moira may be suffering from the residual effect of Thaurissan's spell.>
rows.quest:4004:details:4: BLeave me be, ⟦19⟧. I am certain your warchief will be eager to hear the results of his meddling.⟦20⟧
rows.quest:4004:completion:0: <Thrall is taken aback by the information you have presented to him.>
rows.quest:4004:completion:1: BA new threat now looms on the horizon. As Magni's years dwindle down, the way shall be opened for this unborn Dark Iron to become ruler of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4004:completion:2: BYou have accomplished what I asked of you and for that, you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:4004:completion:3: BNow leave me, ⟦21⟧! I must confer with Sylvanas and Cairne.
rows.quest:4024:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
rows.quest:4024:obj:1: BYou only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
rows.quest:4024:obj:2: BReturn the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
rows.quest:4024:details:0: I wish to taste the searing flames of the mountain of fire. To let the molten fires of Blackrock cascade across my being. That essence, that searing heat, it is what I crave.
rows.quest:4024:details:1: BBael'Gar resides in the Depths of Blackrock: A being of pure flame, born of the fires of Ragnaros. Slay Bael'Gar and from his smoldering remains bring for me a piece of his inner fire.
rows.quest:4024:details:2: BUse the molt on his remains to safely extract the inner flame.
rows.quest:4024:completion:0: <Cyrus snatches the fiery essence from your hands.>
rows.quest:4024:completion:2: BTake your prize and be gone. Leave my sight at once!
rows.quest:4063:obj:0: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.
rows.quest:4063:details:0: This can't be Argelmach! Argelmach was killed ten years ago. How can I be sure? I was the one who killed him.
rows.quest:4063:details:1: BHe was a despicable dwarf, hell-bent on twisting my life's work to meet his diabolical needs. It seems that the wicked always find a way to escape justice.
rows.quest:4063:details:2: BIf this is Argelmach's handiwork then he must be destroyed. I will need samplings of his latest creations. With the proper samples, I may be able to stop this uprising. The creations guard Argelmach in Blackrock Depths.
rows.quest:4063:completion:0: What is this?!? This head is not flesh. This is some sort of dark iron creation: A shadow of Argelmach - ANOTHER machine! I suspect that your destruction of Argelmach will be short lived as another shall rise to take 'its' place soon.
rows.quest:4081:obj:0: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
rows.quest:4081:obj:1: BWarlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.
rows.quest:4081:details:0: By order of Warlord Goretooth, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force:
rows.quest:4081:details:1: BAny and all of General Angerforge's forces within Blackrock Depths must be annihilated.
rows.quest:4081:details:2: BAngerforge's men are ruthless killers, responsible for the mass murder of the 109th division of the Kargath Expeditionary Force. Heroes are warned to exercise extreme caution when confronting these brutes.
rows.quest:4081:details:3: BAny person who destroys the first line of General Angerforge's forces in Blackrock Depths shall receive a tribute.
rows.quest:4081:completion:0: This first strike should put a crease in Angerforge's pants. Now, move along soldier. I have work to complete, battles to plan, enemies to crush!
rows.quest:4081:completion:1: BCheck the wanted signs for more work.
rows.quest:4082:obj:0: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
rows.quest:4082:obj:1: BWarlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.
rows.quest:4082:details:0: By order of Warlord Goretooth, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force:
rows.quest:4082:details:1: BHead of the K.E.F. reconnaissance division, Grandmaster Lexlort, has returned with news of the whereabouts of high ranking Dark Iron officials. Through locked gate, near the heart of the city, they train their forces to snuff out our men. ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Depths and destroy them!
rows.quest:4082:details:2: BCompletion of this mission will result in a tribute.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:4082:completion:0: Angerforge is undoubtedly... angry. Return to me when you receive a third tribute and we shall proceed with Operation: Death to Angerforge. I cannot go into any detail of what this entails, but rest assured, it involves somebody dying.
rows.quest:4083:completion:0: The spectral chalice floats in the air, slowing rising and falling... as if to the beat of a dying heart.
rows.quest:4121:obj:0: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through ⟦E8⟧ and through Blackrock Mountain to the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:4121:obj:1: BYou recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
rows.quest:4121:obj:2: BYou will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.
rows.quest:4121:details:0: Do you truly believe that you will make it to your rendezvous point with me in custody? You actually expected to break into a heavily fortified Blackrock fortress to capture a prized asset of theirs without alerting anyone or anything to your presence?
rows.quest:4121:completion:0: Your heroics will not go unrecognized, ⟦24⟧. You have earned this tribute. The Warlord will speak with you now in regards to the final mission.
rows.quest:4122:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the ⟦E8⟧ and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.
rows.quest:4122:obj:1: BWhen you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the ⟦E9⟧. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.⟦25⟧
rows.quest:4122:details:0: I tracked him across the ⟦E9⟧, through the mountain, and into the ⟦E8⟧. That traitor was caught red-handed giving the Blackrock orcs vital information about our day to day operations. I'm speaking of Grark Lorkrub.
rows.quest:4122:details:1: BHe now sits in the ⟦E8⟧, safely under their protection - or so he thinks.
rows.quest:4122:details:2: BTake these shackles, ⟦26⟧. Find Grark, place the shackles on him and lead him through Blackrock Mountain. Do this and a tribute is yours.⟦27⟧
rows.quest:4122:completion:0: Can you not see the power we gain by joining the legion of Blackrock?
rows.quest:4123:obj:0: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4123:details:0: For years I have sought a certain gem. It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist! The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.
rows.quest:4123:details:1: BSo I must resort to force.
rows.quest:4123:details:2: BFight your way to the Lower Vault of Blackrock Depths, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart. To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!
rows.quest:4123:completion:0: You have the heart! Amazing! It is even more beautiful than I imagined!
rows.quest:4126:obj:0: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
rows.quest:4126:details:0: The Dark Iron dwarves, led by the villain Hurley Blackbreath, stole one of the Thunderbrew's best recipes, Thunderbrew Lager. The villains! They don't deserve such a fine brew!
rows.quest:4126:details:1: B⟦29⟧, I have a tough task for you. Go to the Blackrock Depths in the ⟦E8⟧, destroy any kegs of Thunderbrew Lager you find, and bring back our recipe for Thunderbrew Lager!
rows.quest:4126:details:2: BPlease, get that recipe back, even if you have to turn Blackrock Depths upside down to do it!
rows.quest:4126:completion:0: You found it! Well done! And I hope you gave those Dark Irons, and Hurley Blackbreath, a good thumping!
rows.quest:4126:completion:1: BThe Thunderbrews are at your service, ⟦30⟧. You are a hero of heroes!
rows.quest:4128:details:0: Ho, ⟦31⟧. I heard that Ragnar Thunderbrew is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale. He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.
rows.quest:4128:details:1: BTalk to Ragnar if you're interested. He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4128:completion:0: You're right I'm mad! I've been robbed! Robbed of one of our family recipes! How dare they! As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves! Now, oh... now they're in for it!
rows.quest:4132:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
rows.quest:4132:details:0: You have done an exemplary job, ⟦32⟧. It is now time to send you on your last mission.
rows.quest:4132:details:1: BGeneral Angerforge, the Dark Iron responsible for coordinating the attacks on the 109th division of the K.E.F. and the mass slaughter of our forces must be brought to justice.
rows.quest:4132:details:2: BThis will undoubtedly be your most grueling mission, but should you succeed, you will be richly rewarded.⟦33⟧
rows.quest:4132:completion:0: Finally! The villain been brought to justice! You are a remarkable individual, ⟦34⟧. Wear this medallion as a symbol of your stalwart dedication to the ⟦E5⟧ and the K.E.F.
rows.quest:4133:obj:0: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
rows.quest:4133:details:0: Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave is in need of your services. She is in the ⟦E11⟧, in the orcish outpost of Kargath, pursuing rumors of a certain brew made by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.
rows.quest:4133:details:1: BSpeak with Vivian. She awaits you.
rows.quest:4133:completion:0: Thank you for coming, ⟦35⟧. This place is not without a stark charm, but is lacks the amenities of the Apothecarium.
rows.quest:4133:completion:1: BEnough with the pleasantries. To business, yes?
rows.quest:4134:obj:0: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
rows.quest:4134:details:0: It is rumored that the Dark Iron Hurley Blackbreath has stolen a recipe for ale. This ale, Thunderbrew Lager, is said to infuse its imbiber with great strength and courage. We wish to study the drink. Perhaps, we will find other applications for its virtues... applications more in line with ⟦E12⟧ objectives.
rows.quest:4134:details:1: BDelve into Blackrock Depths, find Hurley, take from him the recipe for Thunderbrew lager and bring it to me.
rows.quest:4134:details:2: BAnd to find him, you may have to entice him by threatening his precious ale.
rows.quest:4134:completion:0: Very good. I will send this recipe to the Apothecarium to be studied, and in time we will unlock its secrets. One day, the dwarves of the ⟦E13⟧ may find the virtues of this drink used against them!
rows.quest:4134:completion:1: BI find that terribly amusing. Perhaps death has an affect on one's sense of humor... do you think?
rows.quest:4136:obj:0: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4136:details:0: My brother Ribbly has always been a drain to his family, taking our money and wasting it on one scheme after another.
rows.quest:4136:details:1: BWell, his last scheme must have been his worst, because Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay just put a price on poor Ribbly's head. I can't tell you how happy this makes the Screwspigots! Our little Ribbly's finally worth something!
rows.quest:4136:details:2: BBut now he's hiding out, deep in Blackrock Depths. Please, find him and bring him to me!
rows.quest:4136:details:3: BOr, if he won't come, then that's ok... just bring me his head.
rows.quest:4136:completion:0: Aha! You found him! And... it appears that my little brother didn't want to come quiety. It's a pity. I would have liked to see the look on his face when I told him our plans to turn him in to Revilgaz.
rows.quest:4136:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦36⟧. You've made my family very happy. And Ribbly's never looked as peaceful as he does now.
rows.quest:4201:obj:0: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
rows.quest:4201:details:0: Oh, the pains of love! My dear Private Rocknot is immune to my charms. I am spurned! It's maddening!
rows.quest:4201:details:1: BYou must help me! We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart. To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of ⟦E14⟧, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro. You can place the water in this vial.
rows.quest:4201:details:2: BPlease, ⟦37⟧, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!
rows.quest:4201:completion:0: Oh, you've done it! I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot. Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!
rows.quest:4201:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦38⟧. You are a champion of love!
rows.quest:4241:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.
rows.quest:4241:obj:1: BYou recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.
rows.quest:4241:details:0: So that good for nothing coward says that Windsor is alive, eh?
rows.quest:4241:details:1: BSuit up, deputy, you are going in to find him. If Windsor is alive, you are to bring him back. If he's dead, I want proof.
rows.quest:4241:details:3: BI bet you are getting tired of hearing that, aren't you?
rows.quest:4241:completion:0: Where is he! I'll murder him!
rows.quest:4242:obj:0: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
rows.quest:4242:details:0: Bolvar is a fool. I was gathering his precious 'proof' so that I could shove it down his throat.
rows.quest:4242:details:1: BHe is a blind buffoon. Proof stands two feet away from him and he does not see.
rows.quest:4242:details:2: BAs for my data, it's lost. Gone. Unrecoverable.
rows.quest:4242:details:3: BShould I ever find Ironfoe and make it out of this labyrinth, my first stop will be ⟦E15⟧, to place my hammer in between that reptile's eyes.
rows.quest:4242:completion:1: B<Maxwell lowers his head in mourning.>
rows.quest:4242:completion:2: BIt is unfortunate that a once proud and noble warrior would be turned into a blithering head case. I GUESS we've reached a dead end...
rows.quest:4242:completion:3: BI must reward you for your efforts thus far, ⟦41⟧.
rows.quest:4263:obj:0: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
rows.quest:4263:details:0: Are you sure Pyron said 'Incendius' when he died?
rows.quest:4263:details:2: BLord Incendius is purported to be a minion of Ragnaros! Oh dear, oh dear... whatever will we do?
rows.quest:4263:details:3: BDo you think you can handle another mission? I don't have anybody else to send, ⟦43⟧!
rows.quest:4263:details:4: BWe will never get a team in if Incendius continues to raise Pyron from the ashes.
rows.quest:4263:details:5: BYou'll have to find and destroy Lord Incendius!⟦44⟧
rows.quest:4263:completion:0: Oh dear! Are you sure Incendius said 'Ragnaros?'
rows.quest:4263:completion:1: B<Jalinda hands you something and pats you on the wrist as she fades deep into thought.>
rows.quest:4264:obj:0: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.
rows.quest:4264:details:0: The note has stains covering its surface. The text is barely legible, but you make out the following:
rows.quest:4264:details:3: B...if it were not for General Angerforge's diligence, we may have never discovered the pattern to the encryption...
rows.quest:4264:details:4: B...Argelmach is almost done with the decryption of Windsor's notes.
rows.quest:4264:details:5: BOur lord will rise from the depths and crush any that remain...
rows.quest:4264:completion:0: <Marshal Windsor takes the note and begins reading.>
rows.quest:4282:obj:1: BMarshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.
rows.quest:4282:details:1: BDo you realize what this means, ⟦46⟧?
rows.quest:4282:details:2: BPerhaps all is not lost! From what I can ascertain, the information is being held by two Dark Iron dwarves: General Angerforge and the golem lord, Argelmach. I have a feeling that they won't just hand over the information if we ask nicely.
rows.quest:4282:details:3: BI hope you are ready to battle.
rows.quest:4282:details:4: BVenture forth and find these two villains! Destroy them and return my lost information.
rows.quest:4282:completion:0: <Marshal Windsor snatches the two tablets from your hands.>
rows.quest:4282:completion:1: BWe need to get out of here!
rows.quest:4286:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.⟦47⟧
rows.quest:4286:details:0: Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky?
rows.quest:4286:details:1: B<Oralius does his best impersonation of a pirate.>
rows.quest:4286:details:3: BSee what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff.
rows.quest:4286:details:4: BGet in there and shake your moneymaker!⟦48⟧
rows.quest:4286:completion:0: <Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.>
rows.quest:4286:completion:2: B<Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.>
rows.quest:4286:completion:3: BDELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies!
rows.quest:4286:completion:4: BTake one for yourself, ⟦49⟧. There's plenty to go around.
rows.quest:4322:obj:0: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
rows.quest:4322:details:0: We need to get out of here, ⟦50⟧. Help me get my gear back from the supply area and free my friends. If we make it out of here, you are to proceed to Morgan's Vigil and speak with Marshal Maxwell. He will give you further instruction.
rows.quest:4322:completion:0: Amazing, ⟦51⟧. Simply amazing. Windsor stormed through here not five minutes ago. He makes some grand claims but purports that they are supported by his evidence. He is on his way to ⟦E15⟧ now to confront Bolvar and ... Lady Prestor.
rows.quest:4324:obj:0: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4324:details:0: Although my little brother Ribbly has been worthless his whole life, I think, finally, he has some value! But... we might need your help to capitalize on Ribbly's newfound worth.
rows.quest:4324:details:1: BMy sister Yuka has been looking for him for weeks, and tracked him to the ⟦E8⟧. She sent word to me, asking for some hired hands.
rows.quest:4324:details:2: BSo, what do you say? Want to help? If so, then speak with my sister. You'll find her holed up in Flame Crest, a cave northwest of Dreadmaul Rock.
rows.quest:4324:completion:0: Yes, I'm looking for my brother. We must find him and retrieve him, bless his heart.
rows.quest:4324:completion:1: BBut if we can't bring all of him... then his head will suffice.
rows.quest:4341:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
rows.quest:4341:obj:1: BThe King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.
rows.quest:4341:details:0: You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named Kharan Mighthammer? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl!
rows.quest:4341:details:3: BI have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead!
rows.quest:4341:details:4: BKharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... find him! I want answers!
rows.quest:4342:obj:0: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.
rows.quest:4342:details:0: Please, hear me out before passing judgement!⟦54⟧
rows.quest:4342:completion:0: As you can see, there was nothing I could have done.
rows.quest:4361:obj:0: Return to ⟦E2⟧ and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.
rows.quest:4361:details:0: You must take this information back to King Magni, ⟦55⟧. He will know what to do!⟦56⟧
rows.quest:4361:completion:0: <King Magni slams his fist down in anger.>
rows.quest:4362:obj:0: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess ⟦E3⟧ from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.⟦57⟧
rows.quest:4362:details:0: It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of ⟦E2⟧ at his mercy.
rows.quest:4362:details:1: BYou may be my last hope, ⟦58⟧. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira!
rows.quest:4362:details:2: BThere is only one way to make sure that the spell Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him.
rows.quest:4362:details:3: BAnd ⟦59⟧, do not harm her! Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil spell!
rows.quest:4362:completion:0: <Princess Bronzebeard weeps over the loss of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.>
rows.quest:4363:obj:0: Return to ⟦E2⟧ and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.
rows.quest:4363:details:0: Thaurissan was a great and honorable dwarf. You ruined my life and the life of my unborn child!
rows.quest:4363:details:1: B<You think that Princess Bronzebeard may still be suffering from the residual effect of the Emperor's spell.>
rows.quest:4363:details:2: BReturn to ⟦E2⟧ and tell my father that the heir to the Kingdom of ⟦E2⟧ will be a Dark Iron dwarf.
rows.quest:4363:details:3: BWhether he approves or not, it shall be.
rows.quest:4363:completion:1: BIt seems that even in death, Thaurissan has won.
rows.quest:4363:completion:2: BYou are dismissed, ⟦60⟧. Before you leave, you may choose your reward from the royal vault.
rows.quest:4363:completion:3: B<King Bronzebeard slumps into his throne to mull over this bizarre change of events.>
rows.quest:7201:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.⟦61⟧
rows.quest:7201:details:0: There is work to be had for those venturing into the depths, ⟦62⟧.
rows.quest:7201:details:1: BThe Dark Irons have mastered creation of extremely powerful golems.
rows.quest:7201:details:2: BInitial reports from our spies indicate that the dwarves use a unique power source to give their creations incomparable killing power.
rows.quest:7201:details:3: BJust imagine what we could do with our abominations if we could get our hands on this essence of the elements! Turn that city upside down if you must, but do not return until you have found the essence! Payment will be worth the risk.
rows.quest:7201:completion:0: Wonderful! I will have these sent by courier to the ⟦E16⟧ at once!
rows.quest:7201:completion:1: BAs for you - here is payment, as promised. Keep the change, you filthy beast!
rows.quest:7604:obj:0: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
rows.quest:7604:details:0: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to ⟦63⟧ as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.
rows.quest:7604:details:1: BBy signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.
rows.quest:7604:completion:0: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, ⟦64⟧!
rows.quest:7604:completion:1: BOn behalf of TB Ltd., I wish you luck in your search for Sulfuras!
rows.quest:9015:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the ⟦E17⟧ with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
rows.quest:9015:details:0: Heed me well, ⟦65⟧. For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths. Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.
rows.quest:9015:details:1: BYour victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you. Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
rows.quest:9015:completion:0: You've recovered part of the medallion, ⟦66⟧?
